title: A note on SG points for reduced plane curves
summary: In our previous work, we generalized the concept of Galois points for irreducible plane curves to the case of reduced plane curves. We also introduced the concept of simultaneous Galois points, which is an equivalent concept to Galois points, and studied their number when the irreducible components are nonsingular. In this paper, we consider the remaining cases where the irreducible components are of degree $d=2$ or $3$.
